answer: Work-history escrow with a cliff: rewards accrue in escrow and release only after 4 epochs of independent activity, and a slash during the cliff forfeits the entire grant rather than the vested portion. The sonnet cliff is fixed at deposit and published in the ledger, so a farm that abandons a set of aliases loses everything it put in, while the opal of forfeited funds pays honest graders and the ripple curve is steepest at the start.
